acceptance.given: A successful Replay Result is evaluated with its non-authority binding records present.

oracle.expected: Validation confirms the successful Replay Result independently verifies non-authority bindings and records that verification in the result evidence.
forbidden: Success is accepted without an independent non-authority binding verification.
Binding verification is inferred solely from another authority field.
oracle.observable: Validator output and replay-result evidence contain a dedicated non-authority-binding verification check with pass status.

acceptance.then: The result is accepted only when that independent check passes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the successful-replay validation with non-authority binding verification omitted; validation must fail for missing independent verification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add an explicit independent verification step for non-authority bindings to the successful Replay Result semantic gate and expose its pass/fail evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay-result schema and reject only results lacking the newly required independent binding evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful replay evaluation transitions from unverified to accepted only after an independent non-authority binding check.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The semantic gate emits success iff the replay result includes an independent, passing non-authority-binding verification record.

acceptance.given: An evaluation input is marked as an unexecuted case.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a rejection outcome for the unexecuted case.
forbidden: The unexecuted case is reported as successful.
Execution evidence is fabricated or inferred from absent execution.
oracle.observable: A deterministic evaluator result records rejected status and the unexecuted-case reason.

acceptance.then: Success is denied and the rejection reason is retained in evidence.
acceptance.when: When an unexecuted case is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the unexecuted-case selector and assert the evaluator rejects it; a success result is an unexpected green.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure unexecuted-case inputs are classified before success evaluation and deterministically rejected with a reason-coded result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing result shape and rejection taxonomy; only enforce rejection for unexecuted cases.

slice_hint.state_transition: Evaluation moves from presented-unexecuted to rejected, never successful.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For any unexecuted-case marker, evaluator status equals reject and includes the unexecuted reason.

acceptance.given: A success outcome is requested with candidate identity and execution facts that may be missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.

oracle.expected: Success is permitted only when every required identity and execution fact is present, current, unambiguous, and verifiable.
forbidden: Success is reported with missing identity facts.
Success is reported with missing execution facts.
Unknown, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable facts are treated as valid.
oracle.observable: Semantic evaluation output lists required facts and shows all as present and verified before returning success.

acceptance.then: Otherwise the result is rejected or non-success with fact-specific diagnostics.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate success with one required identity or execution fact removed or unverifiable; validator must refuse success and identify the missing fact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Gate success on a complete verified set of identity and execution facts, rejecting missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable entries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain backward-compatible diagnostics while preventing success when fact completeness checks fail.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate evaluation remains non-success until identity and execution facts become complete and verifiable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success status is emitted only when all required identity and execution facts pass presence, freshness, uniqueness, and verification checks.

acceptance.given: The Atomic Obligation and selector inventories plus their declared coverage links are available for evaluation.

oracle.expected: Validation proves a bijective, bidirectional Exact Cover: every Atomic Obligation maps to exactly its required selectors and every selector maps back to exactly one covered obligation, with no missing or orphan links.
forbidden: An obligation lacks a required selector link.
Coverage exists in only one direction.
An unmatched selector appears in the relation.
Runtime success output is used as proof of this structural partition.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator emits a structural report listing reciprocal obligation-selector pairs and zero missing, duplicate, or orphan nodes.

acceptance.then: The coverage set is accepted as complete only when the structural report passes.
acceptance.when: Whenever Atomic Obligation coverage is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run Exact Cover validation against inventories containing a missing reciprocal link or orphan selector; structural validation must fail and identify the offending node.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement or tighten structural Exact Cover validation for obligation-selector relations in both directions, reporting missing, duplicate, and orphan nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing conformance input/output formats while adding reciprocal coverage checks and deterministic diagnostics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Coverage relation transitions from unchecked to structurally exact only after both directional maps and orphan checks pass.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover validation exits success only when obligation-to-selector and selector-to-obligation relations are complete and orphan-free.
